snippet.title: Nancy Drew Treasure in the Royal Tower Fan Project
snippet.description:
This is a trailer for my Nancy Drew TRT Remaster game dev project made in Unreal Engine. I hope you enjoy!

If you'd like to try it out for yourself here's the link:
https://defaultcubegames.itch.io/nancy-drew-treasure-in-the-royal

And to keep up with news on new projects, games, and behinds the scenes info, check out:
https://www.facebook.com/DefaultCubeGames/

--------------------------

DISCLAIMER
THIS IS A FAN PROJECT
This project is not approved by, commissioned by, or affiliated with IP owners HER Interactive and Simon & Schuster. 
 
The purpose of this project was as a game development learning exercise.  In making this project public, my only intent is to share it completely non-commercially with other fans of the Nancy Drew series.

If I receive word that this project oversteps its boundaries or violates any laws, I will remove it from its hosting site.
